spec.description: The Docker VM itself (node-exporter), every P2 container (cAdvisor), and the monitoring stack watching them.

spec.title: VM mem free
spec.description: Available memory in the Docker VM, whoever uses it.

spec.title: VM CPU
spec.description: All cores, 5 min average.

spec.title: Swap used
spec.description: Memory pushed to disk. Growing means the VM ran short.

spec.title: Disk free
spec.description: Docker's disk (images, volumes, build cache): the largest real filesystem in the VM.

spec.expr: 100 * max(node_filesystem_avail_bytes / node_filesystem_size_bytes and on (device, mountpoint) topk(1, node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"}))

spec.title: Containers
spec.description: P2 compose containers cAdvisor sees running.

spec.title: P2 memory
spec.description: Working set of the whole compose stack.

spec.title: P2 CPU
spec.description: 1 = one full core.

spec.title: (Re)starts 1h
spec.description: P2 containers created or restarted in the last hour. make up/upv recreate them; a count you didn't cause is a crash.

spec.title: CPU by mode
spec.description: Busy share of all cores. iowait = waiting on disk.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Cache is given back on demand; swap in use means it wasn't enough.

spec.title: Load average
spec.description: Runnable tasks. Above the core count, work queues.

spec.title: Pressure: time stalled waiting
spec.description: Share of time tasks waited on a resource (Linux PSI): the clearest sign of an overfull VM.

spec.title: Disk I/O
spec.description: All disks of the VM.

spec.title: Network
spec.description: node-exporter's view of the network.

spec.title: Memory by service
spec.description: Working set per container, stacked: the total is P2's footprint.

spec.title: Largest now
spec.description: The ten largest, biggest first.

spec.title: CPU by service (cores)
spec.description: 1 = one full core.

spec.title: Busiest now (cores)
spec.description: The ten busiest, busiest first.

spec.title: Network received
spec.description: Per container.

spec.title: Network sent
spec.description: Per container.

spec.title: Disk writes
spec.description: The eight heaviest writers.

spec.title: Memory pressure by service
spec.description: Share of time each container waited for memory.

spec.description: Containers that started again within the hour.

spec.title: OOM kills (1h)
spec.description: Killed for exceeding memory. Empty is good.

spec.title: Series stored
spec.description: Distinct time series Prometheus holds.

spec.description: Data points written per second.
